oracle: Eight independent real Chrome captures through Pirc Markdown enhancement and pinned Mermaid. Per-capture data includes the RequirementDB raw projection and Mermaid graph input, SVG node field/foreignObject bounds and computed styles, divider geometry, edge paths and labels, markers, viewBox, and light/dark theme values.

productionInitialization.theme: base for light and dark for dark, selected by the production matchMedia path
productionInitialization.screen: Playwright screen emulation uses the same CSS width and height as the viewport; each capture records measured screen and availWidth.
